delivery.say: free delivery · food delivery · pay for delivery
ex: Is delivery free for this order?
The delivery comes tomorrow morning.
Can I pay for delivery by card?
We often order pizza for home delivery.

game show.say: on a game show · a game show host
ex: My grandmother watches a game show every evening.
He won a new car on a TV game show.
Would you like to be on a game show?
The game show host asks very easy questions.
We need new sheets for our king-size bed.
Does the hotel room have a king-size bed?
A king-size bed is too big for this room.
I bought a king-size pizza for the whole family.
king-size.note: Also "king-sized". It means very large, most often about beds: "a king-size bed."

tour manager.say: work as a tour manager · the band's tour manager
ex: The band's tour manager books all the hotels.
Our tour manager meets us at the airport.
Can I speak to the tour manager, please?
She works as a tour manager for a rock band.
tour manager.note: A person who organizes a tour; a person who sells trips is a "travel agent."

ex: Our guest room has a queen-size bed.
Do these sheets fit a queen-size bed?
A queen-size bed is smaller than a king-size bed.
We want a queen-size mattress for our bedroom.
queen-size.note: Also "queen-sized". A queen-size bed is a little smaller than a king-size bed.

garden center.say: at the garden center · go to the garden center
ex: We buy flowers and seeds at the garden center.
Is the garden center open on Sundays?
The garden center sells small trees and plant pots.
Let's go to the garden center this weekend.

pet shop.say: at the pet shop · go to the pet shop
ex: We buy food for our cat at the pet shop.
Is there a pet shop near here?
The pet shop sells fish, birds, and small dogs.
My daughter wants a hamster from the pet shop.
pet shop.note: In American English, "pet store" is more common.

laser show.say: watch a laser show · a laser show at the concert
ex: There is a big laser show in the park tonight.
What time does the laser show start?
The laser show at the concert was amazing.
Kids love the laser show at the science museum.
This radio station plays a lot of world music.
Do you know any good world music festivals?
The shop has a world music section with African songs.
She sings world music in five different languages.
world music.note: Traditional or folk music from different countries, often outside the US and Europe.

ex: The old factory is now an art space for young artists.
Is the art space open to visitors on Mondays?
The art space has a new photo exhibition this month.
Local artists can rent a room in the art space.
The title track is my favorite song on the album.
The album and its title track have the same name.
Can you play the title track from their new album?
The band plays the title track at every concert.
title track.note: The song that has the same name as the album.

ex: The hotel has a sky bar on the top floor.
We had drinks at a sky bar with a great view.
Is the sky bar open to everyone, not just hotel guests?
You can see the whole city from the sky bar.
sky bar.note: Often part of a name; "rooftop bar" is the more common word.

ex: Acid house became popular in British clubs in the 1980s.
My dad still listens to old acid house records.
The DJ played acid house music until three in the morning.
Do you know any good acid house songs?
acid house.note: A type of electronic dance music from the late 1980s.

ex: The line producer plans the budget for the film.
A line producer makes sure filming stays on schedule.
She works as a line producer for a TV company.
Ask the line producer if we can hire more actors.
line producer.note: The person who manages the daily work and money of a film or TV show.

ex: The production designer chooses how every room in the film looks.
She works as a production designer for TV shows.
The production designer won an award for this movie.
Our production designer built a whole street for the film.
production designer.note: The person who creates the look of the sets in a film or TV show.

ex: The DJ plays progressive house at the club on Fridays.
Progressive house songs are often long and build slowly.
Do you like progressive house or techno more?
This radio show plays only progressive house and trance.
My brother's band plays loud garage rock in the basement.
Garage rock songs are usually short, simple, and noisy.
Is there a good garage rock concert this weekend?
The radio station plays old garage rock from the 1960s.
My sister works in asset management at a big bank.
The company offers asset management for small businesses.
Good asset management helps you protect your money.
Do you need a degree for a job in asset management?
asset management.note: Managing investments and property for people or companies.

ex: The casting director chooses actors for the new film.
Send your photos and a short video to the casting director.
The casting director wants to see you again tomorrow.
How did you meet the casting director?
Bring your old clothes to our swap party on Saturday.
At a swap party, people trade things they don't need.
We are having a book swap party at the library.
Can I bring my kids' old toys to the swap party?
swap party.note: Usually for clothes; also called a "clothing swap."

ex: The hotel has an infinity pool with an ocean view.
Water from an infinity pool seems to fall off the edge.
We took photos by the infinity pool at sunset.
Is the infinity pool on the roof open in winter?
infinity pool.note: A pool whose edge seems to disappear into the view.

ex: The director uses a jump cut to skip time in the scene.
Many video bloggers use jump cuts to remove pauses.
A jump cut can make a video feel fast and exciting.
How do I add a jump cut in this editing app?
The city built a new pump track for bikes in the park.
Kids ride their bikes on the pump track after school.
On a pump track, you move by pushing, not pedaling.
Is the pump track open to scooters too?
pump track.note: A loop of small hills where you ride a bike without pedaling.

ex: Witch house is a dark kind of electronic music.
Many witch house songs have slow beats and strange voices.
He started making witch house music in his bedroom.
Do you know any good witch house artists?
Cloud rap has soft, dreamy beats and slow lyrics.
My son listens to cloud rap while he studies.
This young artist became famous for her cloud rap songs.
Can you recommend some good cloud rap songs?
The club plays minimal techno every Saturday night.
Minimal techno uses only a few sounds and repeats them.
Some people find minimal techno boring, but I love it.
Do you know any good minimal techno DJs?
We take the car for detailing before we sell it.
Car detailing includes cleaning the seats and polishing the paint.
How much does full detailing cost for a small car?
He runs a small car detailing business in his garage.
detailing.note: Also the -ing form of "detail": "a report detailing the costs."

ex: There is a smoothie bar next to the gym.
I get a banana drink at the smoothie bar every morning.
Does the smoothie bar have drinks without sugar?
The new smoothie bar uses only fresh fruit.
Emo rap mixes hip-hop beats with sad, emotional lyrics.
My teenage son listens to emo rap all the time.
Many emo rap songs are about loneliness and pain.
Is emo rap still popular with young people?
The restaurant offers free valet parking for its guests.
Is valet parking available at the hotel tonight?
With valet parking, a worker parks your car for you.
Valet parking costs twenty dollars a night here.
valet parking.note: The worker who parks your car is called a "valet."
